items.failureBehavior: The decoder rejects and reports invalid level data; the caller substitutes the smallest valid fallback level/default values before invoking the decoder so normal game operation continues.
items.text: At level decoding, validate every dimension, count, coordinate, time, and tile/enemy value before allocation or retention: dimensions and counts must be non-negative and within the game’s configured practical level bounds, score/duration-derived numbers must be non-negative integers, and invalid data must be rejected and reported before recordRunEnd reads it.

items.failureBehavior: Existing behavior is not established as safe; the proposed achievement integration must not rely on unchecked level fields.
items.text: The binary level parser reads width, height, time, tile values, enemy count, and per-enemy fields from a DataInputStream, allocates levelEntities from parsed dimensions, and loops according to parsed counts without an evident bounded-input validation step.
